verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent capabilities. Graph delta queries and change notifications report created, updated, or deleted items through a documented API, and version history can be retained, which gives a limited, API-accessible record of file changes. Nothing in the pack describes actual audit or event logs covering who did what, sharing, or access events, nor any SIEM export. Missing for 10: dedicated audit/event log documentation, actor-level activity records, SIEM export or integration, admin audit log API, independent corroboration.
